title: Add release workflow: tag, build, publish binaries as GitHub releases
description:
Add .github/workflows/release.yml triggered on tag push (v*.*.*). Builds release binaries for linux-amd64, linux-arm64. Packages each binary with example configs and README. Creates a GitHub release with the binaries attached. Artifact: .github/workflows/release.yml.

Acceptance: pushing a v0.1.0 tag creates a GitHub release with attached tarballs; release is a draft until manually published
